<ApiTitle method="post" title="Create Bulk Batch" />

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/turbosign/bulk/ingest"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Sends one document to many sets of signers by creating a batch of 10 to 1,000 jobs that are processed in the background. Credits for every job are reserved up front, and your plan must include bulk sending.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
